brief: A Goldman prime brokerage note tracks hedge fund strategy performance across Nov 4 and intraday Nov 5. On Nov 4, broader markets rose, but a rotation from semiconductor stocks into software stocks drove a sharp sell-off in the US momentum factor. Despite that, systematic long/short funds ended slightly up as gains in EM Asia offset US losses, global fundamental (discretionary) strategies rose on the broad market rally, and multi-strategy funds were only modestly lower. The picture reverses intraday on Nov 5 (~10:30 EST): US markets are selling off and the global momentum factor is down. Fundamental strategies are down, with US-focused funds hit harder than others, and TMT exposure is severely down. Systematic strategies, however, are positive, while multi-strategy funds are down significantly, driven by their equity exposure. The note reports observed performance across strategy types rather than arguing a single forward-looking thesis.
